tldr_zh: Google Pixel 11漲價、Anthropic推Opus 5模型、多地野火疏散、烏克蘭遭俄轟炸。
tldr_en: Google confirms Pixel 11 price hike; Anthropic releases Opus 5; wildfires force mass evacuation; Russia strikes Ukraine.

items.title_zh: Google證實Pixel 11將漲價　供應鏈壓力推升成本
items.title_en: Google Confirms Pixel 11 Price Hike Amid Supply Pressures
items.summary_zh: Google設備與服務副總裁Shakil Barkat向媒體證實，下一代Pixel手機價格將高於Pixel 10。由於AI資料中心的快速擴展導致RAM供應吃緊，價格上漲反映了全球芯片成本上升的趨勢。
items.summary_en: Google's VP Shakil Barkat confirmed that the Pixel 11 will cost more than its predecessor. The price hike reflects ongoing RAM supply constraints driven by the explosion of AI data center deployments worldwide.

items.title_zh: Anthropic推出Opus 5模型　重點聚焦效率而非性能大躍進
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Opus 5 Model Focusing on Token Efficiency
items.summary_zh: Anthropic發布Opus 5大語言模型，主要改進在於提升Token效率而非能力躍升。該模型反映了業界趨勢：更便宜的選項往往足以滿足多數使用場景，無須最頂級的模型。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Opus 5, prioritizing token efficiency improvements over capability leaps. The update reflects industry trends where cheaper models are often sufficient for most use cases.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek暫停融資　洩露對美國算力差距的評論
items.title_en: DeepSeek Pauses Fundraising After Compute Gap Comments Leaked
items.summary_zh: 中國AI新創DeepSeek因為融資者會議紀錄中關於與美國算力差距的評論遭洩露後，決定暫停融資。此事反映了地緣政治對全球AI競賽的影響。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek paused its fundraising after comments regarding compute gaps with the US were leaked from investor meetings. The incident highlights geopolitical tensions in the global AI race.

items.title_zh: 美國科技巨頭被控違法拒交數據　歐洲監管機構施壓
items.title_en: Big Tech Stonewalling European Researchers on Required Data Disclosure
items.summary_zh: 研究人員指控TikTok、X和Meta等科技巨頭未提供歐洲法律要求的研究用數據。此事凸顯了科技公司與監管當局間的持續衝突。
items.summary_en: Researchers accuse TikTok, X, and Meta of stonewalling on legally required data for European social media research. The dispute highlights ongoing conflicts between tech companies and regulators.

items.title_zh: SpaceX第13次Starship飛行成功　將嘗試塔臂捕捉
items.title_en: SpaceX Eyes Tower Catch for Next Starship After Successful 13th Flight
items.summary_zh: SpaceX的Starship第13次飛行圓滿結束，公司計劃在下次發射中嘗試用塔臂在發射台捕捉返回的助推器。這代表該公司的可重複使用火箭技術向前邁進。
items.summary_en: SpaceX's 13th Starship flight concluded successfully, with plans to attempt tower catch of the booster on the next flight. The progress marks another step forward in reusable rocket technology.

items.title_zh: NASA深空網絡西班牙設施疏散　野火威脅太空任務
items.title_en: Wildfire Forces Evacuation of NASA's Deep Space Network Complex in Spain
items.summary_zh: 西班牙野火蔓延迫使NASA位於當地的深空網絡(DSN)複合設施人員疏散。該設施是維持太空任務通訊的關鍵基礎設施，任何損毀將對全球太空探索活動造成影響。
items.summary_en: A wildfire in Spain forced evacuation of NASA's Deep Space Network complex, which is critical for maintaining communications with space missions. Potential damage assessment will occur once conditions are safe.

items.title_zh: 華納兄弟控告亞馬遜非法挖角高管　掀就業爭議
items.title_en: Warner Bros. Sues Amazon for Illegally Poaching Senior Executives
items.summary_zh: 華納兄弟探索公司對亞馬遜提起訴訟，指控其非法挖角包括原行銷資深副總裁等多名員工。此案可能重新激發關於加州非競爭協議執行力的法律辯論。
items.summary_en: Warner Bros. Discovery sued Amazon, accusing it of illegally poaching executives including a former senior VP of originals marketing. The lawsuit will likely reignite debates on enforceability of non-compete agreements under California law.

items.title_zh: Google緊急推送Chrome 150版本　修補4個高風險漏洞
items.title_en: Google Urgently Updates Chrome 150 to Patch Four High-Risk Vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: Google在本週推送Chrome 150版本更新，並在兩天後再次緊急發布新版本，針對Windows、macOS和Linux修補4個高風險安全漏洞。快速更新頻率反映了漏洞的嚴重性。
items.summary_en: Google released emergency updates to Chrome 150, pushing new versions for Windows, macOS, and Linux to patch four high-risk vulnerabilities. The rapid update cycle reflects the severity of the security issues.

items.title_zh: 法國西班牙野火肆虐　25萬人緊急疏散
items.title_en: Over 250,000 Flee Massive Wildfires in France and Spain
items.summary_zh: 西班牙和法國正遭受嚴重野火威脅，超過25萬人被迫疏散。法國當局表示波爾多附近的火勢遠未受控，西班牙總理警告未來數小時將很複雜。
items.summary_en: More than 250,000 people fled wildfires across France and Spain. French authorities report blazes near Bordeaux remain far from controlled, while Spain's PM warns of complex hours ahead.

items.title_zh: 俄羅斯擬徵北韓軍隊　澤倫斯基誓言烏克蘭將回應
items.title_en: Russia Plans to Recruit 30,000 North Korean Soldiers, Zelensky Vows Response
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基指出俄羅斯計劃徵召3萬名北韓士兵參戰，並稱烏克蘭已準備回應此威脅。此舉顯示俄烏戰爭進入新階段，涉及第三國軍隊參與。
items.summary_en: President Zelensky revealed Russia plans to recruit 30,000 North Korean soldiers for the conflict. Ukraine has begun preparations to respond to this new threat, marking an escalation involving third-country forces.

items.title_zh: 美官員簽證遭拒　巴西抵制對其選舉公正性質疑
items.title_en: Brazil Denies Visas to US Officials Questioning Election Integrity
items.summary_zh: 巴西政府拒絕了川普政府兩名官員的簽證申請，這兩人原計劃前往質疑巴西選舉制度的公正性。此舉反映了巴西對美國干預內政的警惕。
items.summary_en: Brazil rejected visa applications from two Trump administration officials who planned to question the fairness of Brazil's election system. The move reflects Brazil's resistance to perceived US interference in domestic affairs.
